sentence: [Virgo's date range](/virgo-dates/) has the same kind of single-day fuzziness at its boundary, where the publisher ranges and exact yearly ingress also need to be distinguished.

[This site's May 22 zodiac page](/may-22-zodiac/) traces the same mechanic through a different boundary, the Taurus-Gemini line, where published ephemeris tables put the actual crossing on May 20 or May 21, diverging from some horoscope date charts.
A solstice-anchored boundary runs into the same problem from a different direction, which is what [this site's June 22 zodiac page](/june-22-zodiac/) walks through for the Gemini-Cancer line.

That history means Scorpio's dates have no founding moment, not even the contested kind an observance like [National Boyfriend Day](/national-boyfriend-day/) has: two competing origin stories, neither one settled.

Jewelry retailers commonly list topaz or citrine as \"the\" Scorpio stone, but that's simply borrowed from November's monthly birthstone list, the same list documented back to [Jewelers of America's 1912 meeting](/december-birthstone/) for December's entries, and repurposed here for a sign that happens to span late October into November.
